system.description:
Canine people, often living in isolated packs. The Lupid are known to be excellent trackers and hunters, often relying on their superior sense of smell.

Tracker

+1 Examination. [A]

Advantage on any skill check related to using your sense of smell. [M]

Strong urge to howl at the moon. [M]

Nim+ Volume I — submitted by Kazok the Goblin.
